thread:
Jordan L: Heads-up — saw a surge in owner churn on inbound leads overnight (lots of 1-2 minute handoffs). Spike correlates with HubSpot enrichment delays and the RR timeout kicking in. https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Xample -> sample metrics
Mia P: ugh. saw that too. chances are enrichment jitter + claim debounce too low. can we avoid reassigning if owner TTL < 1h? :thinking_face:
Sam R: Agree. Also noticed Salesforce lead records get overwritten when HS webhook retries arrive late. We should add an entropy score to leads and gate reassigns when entropy > threshold.
Olivia C: Love the entropy idea. What's the heuristic? frequent claim_count + enrichment_age + webhook_retries?
Jordan L: Exactly. Proposed quick formula: entropy = min(1, 0.4*claim_count_norm + 0.4*enrichment_delay_norm + 0.2*retry_norm). If entropy > 0.6, do NOT auto-reassign; instead mark for manual ops-review after 30m.
Ben K: That seems reasonable. Can we do an incremental roll? Start with nightshift hours (00:00-08:00) since most churn there.
Mia P: yes please. also add sticky-owner TTL bump to 4h for nightshift. reduces immediate flapping.
Sam R: Implementation notes for HubSpot workflow (can be a stopgap):
```
# HubSpot workflow filter (pseudo)
IF: enrichment_status == 'pending' AND hours_since_create < 2 THEN: set lead.property 'entropy_score' = calculate_entropy(...)
IF: entropy_score > 0.6 THEN: do not trigger round_robin_assign
ELSE: run round_robin_assign
```
Jordan L: And Salesforce assignment rule patch (Apex-ish pseudo):
```
// on insert/update
Double entropy = Lead.CustomEntropy__c;
if(entropy > 0.6) {
  // keep owner, add flag for ops
  lead.addError('High entropy - manual review');
}
```
Olivia C: For the round-robin service, suggestion: add a short backoff window per-lead (90s) with exponential jitter so retries don't pile up. Also expose metric lead_reassign_rate and lead_entropy_percent in console.
Mia P: +1 to observability. We need dashboard cards: "reassigns/hr", "median enrichment delay", "entropy > 0.6 pct".
Ben K: Ops playbook draft: 1) If entropy spike persists > 15m -> pause auto-assign for that region. 2) Run enrichment rehydrate job. 3) Notify SDRs via #sales-alerts with sample records.
Jordan L: Quick patch to round-robin: add check before assign -> if lead.entropy > 0.6 or owner.last_claim_age < sticky_ttl => skip. Minimal change, low risk. I'll open a PR.
Sam R: Can someone drop a sample PR description? I can pickup code once we agree on thresholds.
Mia P: PR body: "Nightshift entropy guard: prevents immediate reassigns when enrichment/webhook jitter causes churn. Adds entropy_score calculation, sticky TTL increase, and metric hooks. Rollout: canary to nightshift -> full roll after 48h if reassign_rate drops >= 40%."
Jordan L: perfect. @Ben K can you coordinate canary with ops (pause/resume toggle)?
Ben K: Yep — I'll add a feature flag and a rollback plan. will also wire ops-bot to alert if reassign_rate goes up after enabling.
ops-bot: [automated] Feature flag created: lead_entropy_guard (default=false). Monitor: marketing -> lead_reassign_rate.
Olivia C: sync? 20m quick call to triage and assign owners for PRs? 10:30 PT works for me.
Mia P: 10:30 PT good. I'll bring dashboard mocks.
Sam R: I'll draft the HubSpot workflow snippet + tests before the call.
Jordan L: thanks all. goal: reduce nightshift owner churn by 50% w/ minimal impact to SLA. follow-ups in thread after call. :thumbsup:
